snippet.title: JOIN US - Real Ex-Cult Members Play | Gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
What happens when real former cult members play a game about starting one?

Former cult members sit down with JOIN US to recruit followers, build their compounds, define their beliefs, and experience the game’s darkly satirical take on cult life.

The reactions are… mixed.

JOIN US is an open-world survival game where you can build your own cult, recruit followers, survive the apocalypse, and play solo or in co-op with up to four players.

Wishlist JOIN US: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3401960/JOIN_US/

Join the Discord: https://discord.com/invite/joinusgame
